subject: Stratus SDK adaptor lifecycle & staggered deprecation proposal
messages:
From: Aditi Sharma <aditi.sharma@stratus.tech>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Eric Wong <eric.wong@stratus.tech>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stratus integration — SDK lifecycle request

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We dug into the SDK v4 preview and there are two breaking items that will impact our adaptor: removal of the legacy sync client surface and the change to the batch/streaming handshake semantics. Our roadmap for the connector is locked for Q1 and we need a firm compatibility guarantee to commit resources.

Ask: Can Redwood commit to a staggered deprecation schedule (12 months for sync client removal + a compatibility shim window) and provide a migration kit and CI harness we can use in our tests?

We (Stratus) are willing to coordinate a joint deprecation advisory (co-branded) and run a canary against your staging infra, but we need snapshots of the compatibility matrix and an ETA for the migration artifacts. Attaching our internal impact spreadsheet for context.

Attachments: stratus-impact-spreadsheet.xlsx (referenced)

Thanks,
Aditi
Partner Engineer, Stratus Technologies


From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Aditi Sharma <aditi.sharma@stratus.tech>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stratus integration — SDK lifecycle request

Hi Aditi —

Really appreciate the clear impact note and the spreadsheet. We want this to be low-friction for you. High-level proposal from Redwood:

- Staggered deprecation: 12-month minimum public notice for removal of legacy sync surface.
- Compatibility shim: we will ship an official adapter shim that restores the legacy sync surface on top of v4 for at least 18 months (shim will be acceptable for production with documented performance caveats).
- Migration kit: a migration guide + automated codemods (PRs) and a lightweight test harness for integration tests.
- Canary program: invite Stratus to our staging canary; we’ll provide a dedicated canary channel and test tokens.

I attached an initial compatibility matrix and a draft migration guide. Marcus / Priyom: can you confirm the effort estimates and whether we can commit to the 18-month shim support window?

Next steps for Stratus: could you send a prioritized list of the top 5 callsites in your adaptor that rely on sync semantics? That helps the codemod scope.

Best,
Sofia
Director, Alliances — Redwood Inference

Attachments: stratus-compatibility-matrix.xlsx; redwood-stratus-migration-guide-v1.pdf

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 13:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stratus integration — SDK lifecycle request

Sofia / team — quick engineering read:

- 12-month public notice for API removal is reasonable.
- 18-month shim support is doable but we should gate the shim on a compatibility SLA (we'll call out performance degradation and unsupported edge-cases).
- For v4 lifetime we should offer an opt-in compatibility flag (runtime toggle) that keeps the legacy handshake semantics; this avoids forcing the shim into everyone’s path. We can document it as an enterprise compatibility toggle.

Estimate: 2.5 engineer-months to build the shim + codemod + tests. Add 0.5 EM for ongoing backports/patches in the 18-month window (security fixes only).

I'll draft an internal runbook: staging canary steps, commit hooks for adaptor PRs, and an integration test checklist. Priyom — can you head up the test harness?

—Marcus
Senior Engineering Manager, Runtime

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Aditi Sharma <aditi.sharma@stratus.tech>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stratus integration — SDK lifecycle request

Aditi —

Happy to own the harness. Quick notes on scope:

- We'll produce a dockerized integration harness that runs your adaptor against the shim + native v4. It will exercise the 10 canonical scenarios you list and generate a compatibility report.
- CI hooks: we can provide a GitHub Actions template and an example workflow you can drop into Stratus CI to run compatibility checks on PRs.
- Sandbox access: request for staging-team SSO (we'll send an invite once NDAs/infra access form is done).

Timeline: prototype harness + Actions template in 3 weeks (by 11/11/2026). Full migration codemod and docs in 6 weeks.

Attachment: adapter-shim-prototype.diff (early patch)

If the Stratus legal team wants a short addendum to the integration agreement clarifying the compatibility window and support cadence, we have a standard addendum we can adapt.

Thanks,
Priyom
Integration Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Aditi Sharma <aditi.sharma@stratus.tech>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Eric Wong <eric.wong@stratus.tech>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 22 Oct 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stratus integration — SDK lifecycle request

Sofia / team — this is excellent, thank you. Stratus accepts the proposed cadence:

- We will prioritize the top 5 callsites and share them by COB Monday (10/25).
- We agree to the 12-month public notice + 18-month shim support; we’d like the opt-in toggle documented and available in the enterprise flagging console.
- Please send the staging SSO invite and the NDAs infra access form. Eric will coordinate legal review on the addendum and circle back with redlines.

We’ll plan the canary run for mid-Nov (we’ll confirm exact dates after we receive tokens and the harness).

Regards,
Aditi
